# pixi-silk

> Smooth vector graphics for PixiJS v8. Every shape is an exact signed distance field, anti-aliased per pixel in the shader, so edges stay smooth at any zoom, rotation and device pixel ratio without MSAA.

pixi-silk 0.1.0 is an MIT-licensed TypeScript library. It needs pixi.js ^8.6 as a peer dependency, and a browser with WebGL2 or WebGPU.

Site: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev
Repository: https://github.com/schmooky/pixi-silk
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/pixi-silk

## Files for AI assistants

- [llms-full.txt](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/llms-full.txt): core, paint and rendering: guides and API, SilkGraphics first.
- [llms-ui.txt](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/llms-ui.txt): text, layout, UI widgets and the editor kit: guides and API.
- [llms-examples.txt](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/llms-examples.txt): whole screens with the source of every demo.
- Every docs and API page has a Markdown twin: replace the trailing slash with `.md` (`/docs/shapes.md`, `/api/classes/SilkGraphics.md`).
- Agent skills ship in the npm package: `node_modules/pixi-silk/skills/pixi-silk/SKILL.md` routes to the rest.

## Quick start

```bash
npm install pixi-silk pixi.js
```

```ts
import { createSilkApp, SilkGraphics, conic, vertical } from 'pixi-silk';

const { app } = await createSilkApp({ parent: document.getElementById('stage')!, background: 0x000000 });
const g = new SilkGraphics();

g.roundRect(10, 10, 340, 140, 22, 0.6).fill(0x1c1c1e); // squircle card
g.arcSweep(80, 80, 44, -Math.PI / 2, Math.PI * 1.5)
    .stroke({ width: 12, cap: 'round', gradient: conic([0x30d158, 0xffd60a, 0xff453a]) });
g.area([120, 100, 170, 80, 220, 92, 270, 60, 320, 70], 130, { smooth: 'monotone' })
    .fill(vertical([[0, 0xff9f0a, 0.8], [1, 0xff9f0a, 0]]))
    .stroke({ width: 2, color: 0xff9f0a, cap: 'round' });
app.stage.addChild(g);
```

## Entry points

Import each from its own path. The root import does not re-export the others.

| Import | Area | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`pixi-silk`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api.md) | Core | SilkGraphics, createSilkApp, gradients (linear, radial, conic, along, mesh), colour and curve helpers, motion helpers, enableSilkBatching. |
| [`pixi-silk/glass`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/glass.md) | Paint | Glass: a frosted pane that blurs and bends what is behind it. |
| [`pixi-silk/glow`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/glow.md) | Paint | Glow, Aurora and light helpers (neon, halo, rays, spectrum). |
| [`pixi-silk/webgpu`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/webgpu.md) | Rendering | enableWebGPU: installs the WGSL shader for your own WebGPU Application. |
| [`pixi-silk/text`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/text.md) | Text | SilkText: distance-field text with outline, shadow and gradient fill. SdfAtlas, layoutText, caret helpers. |
| [`pixi-silk/layout`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/layout.md) | Layout | LayoutNode: a headless flex layout engine with no Pixi in it. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/layout`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/layout.md) | Layout | SmartContainer and FlexContainer: place and scale a design box in the window, flex children inside it. |
| [`pixi-silk/signal`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/signal.md) | UI widgets | signal, computed, watch, batch: the small reactive store every widget state uses. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/radial`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/radial.md) | UI widgets | RadialMenu and bindRadialTrigger: a ring menu with submenus. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/button`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/button.md) | UI widgets | SilkButton: pill, circle or squircle button with press, hold, busy and appear animations. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/dock`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/dock.md) | UI widgets | ButtonDock: a row or column of SilkButtons that closes the gap when one hides. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/halo`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/halo.md) | UI widgets | ContextHalo: a ring of actions around a selected object. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/modes`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/modes.md) | UI widgets | SegmentedSwitch and ModeSwitcher: tool mode pickers, including the hold-a-key ring. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/dial`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/dial.md) | UI widgets | JogDial and Scrubber: rotary and drag-to-change number inputs. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/odometer`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/odometer.md) | UI widgets | Odometer: a rolling number counter with prefix, decimals and count-up timing. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/gesture`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/gesture.md) | UI widgets | trackGesture: tap, hold, flick and drag from one target, with slop per pointer kind. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/arc`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/arc.md) | UI widgets | Angle maths for ring widgets: angleDelta, wrapAngle, snapTo, rubberBand. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/keys`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/keys.md) | UI widgets | Shared keyboard state: isKeyDown, modifier checks, onKey, isTypingTarget. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/pill`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/pill.md) | UI widgets | ValuePill: a small rounded label for live readouts (angles, sizes, distances). |
| [`pixi-silk/ui`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui.md) | UI widgets | Every widget and editor tool in one import. The per-widget subpaths ship less code. |
| [`pixi-silk/selection`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/selection.md) | Editor kit | Selection store and bindOutline, bindGizmo, bindMeasure. |
| [`pixi-silk/history`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/history.md) | Editor kit | History (undo and redo), recordSignals, recordGizmo, bindHistoryKeys. |
| [`pixi-silk/path`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/path.md) | Editor kit | Bezier path model: BezierPath, drawPath, parseSvgPath, pathToSvg and edit operations. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/gizmo`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/gizmo.md) | Editor kit | TransformGizmo: move, rotate, scale and box handles. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/outline`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/outline.md) | Editor kit | SelectionOutline: hover and selection outlines. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/pathgizmo`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/pathgizmo.md) | Editor kit | PathGizmo and PenTool: edit and draw Bezier paths. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/camera`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/camera.md) | Editor kit | Camera: pan and zoom a world container, ZoomControl. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/measure`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/measure.md) | Editor kit | Measure: size labels and red lines between objects. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/grid`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/grid.md) | Editor kit | CanvasGrid: dots or lines that follow the camera. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/ruler`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/ruler.md) | Editor kit | Ruler: screen-edge rulers that follow the camera. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/guides`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/guides.md) | Editor kit | Guides: draggable guide lines from the rulers. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/marquee`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/marquee.md) | Editor kit | Marquee: drag a box to select. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/group`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/group.md) | Editor kit | SelectionGroup: transform several objects as one. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/spacing`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/spacing.md) | Editor kit | SpacingMarkers and findSpacing: equal-gap hints. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/snap`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/snap.md) | Editor kit | SnapEngine and SnapGuides: snap boxes to edges, centres and lines. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/color`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/color.md) | Editor kit | Colour pickers: wheels, rings, OKLCH, channel sliders. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/brush`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/brush.md) | Editor kit | BrushCursor: a brush size and hardness cursor. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/timeline`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/timeline.md) | Editor kit | MiniTimeline: frames, keys, loop range and playback. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/textedit`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/textedit.md) | Editor kit | TextEditor: an editable SilkText field with caret, selection and IME. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/panel`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/panel.md) | Editor kit | Panel: a docked, scrolling side panel drawn on the canvas. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/layers`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/layers.md) | Editor kit | LayerTree: a layer tree over any data through an adapter, with selection and history. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/inspector`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/inspector.md) | Editor kit | Inspector: property fields bound to the selection. |
| [`pixi-silk/ui/minimap`](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/ui/minimap.md) | Editor kit | Minimap: an overview of the world with the camera frame. |

## Gotchas

- WebGL2 is the default renderer. For WebGPU pass `createSilkApp({ preference: 'webgpu' })`, or in your own Pixi app call `enableWebGPU()` from `pixi-silk/webgpu` before you create the first SilkGraphics.
- Stroke joins are `miter` by default, as in Canvas 2D and Pixi. `bevel` and `round` are the others. `miterLimit` defaults to 10.
- Free-form paths (`moveTo`, `lineTo`, Bezier curves, `poly`, `svgPath`) both fill and stroke. A fill paints a path as one exact even-odd shape.
- Shape operations: `fill({ op: 'union' | 'subtract' | 'intersect' | 'exclude' })` on the shapes of the active path, `g.boolean(op, a, b)` to nest them, and `g.svgPath(d)` for SVG path data.
- Batching is off by default: each SilkGraphics is one draw call. Call `enableSilkBatching()` before you create the objects to batch runs of them, on WebGL2 and WebGPU. `{ batch: false }` keeps one object out.
- Each primitive is one instance of 44 floats (11 vec4, 176 bytes).
- The root import holds the core only. UI widgets, editor tools, text, layout, glass, glow and WebGPU are separate entry points such as `pixi-silk/ui/button` or `pixi-silk/text`.
- A SmartContainer does nothing until it has a `viewport` (the Application, its renderer, a signal or a rectangle).
- `clear()` keeps the GPU buffers, so clearing and redrawing a SilkGraphics every frame is cheap.
- There are no texture fills and no `svg()` import. Use gradients, and `svgPath(d)` for path data.

## Docs

The docs are grouped into areas. Each area overview tours its pages.

### Get started

- [Get started overview](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/start/): Install pixi-silk, draw a first scene and move code over from PixiJS Graphics.
- [Introduction](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/introduction/): pixi-silk is a Graphics-like object for PixiJS v8. It draws shapes as exact signed distance fields, so edges stay smooth and anti-aliased at any zoom and DPR. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/introduction.md)
- [Installation](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/installation/): Install pixi-silk with npm, pnpm, yarn or bun next to pixi.js v8. It runs on WebGL2 or WebGPU and ships typed, tree-shakeable ESM, about 15 kB gzipped. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/installation.md)
- [Quick start](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/quick-start/): Create a DPR-exact PixiJS app with createSilkApp, then draw a squircle card, a gradient gauge and an area chart with SilkGraphics. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/quick-start.md)
- [Migrating from Graphics](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/migrating-from-graphics/): SilkGraphics mirrors the PixiJS v8 Graphics API: shapes on a path, fill and stroke, transforms. See what is the same, what differs and what is new. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/migrating-from-graphics.md)

### Drawing

- [Drawing overview](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/drawing/): Every shape SilkGraphics can draw, and how to fill, stroke and move it.
- [Shapes](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/shapes/): Rects, squircles with per-corner radii, pills, circles, ellipses, hearts, stars, polygons and rounded triangles, each an exact anti-aliased distance field. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/shapes.md)
- [Shape operations](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/shape-operations/): Union, subtract, intersect and exclude shapes and SVG paths in PixiJS. Each result is one exact distance field with sharp edges, strokes, gradients and blur. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/shape-operations.md)
- [Arcs, sectors & rings](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/arcs-and-rings/): Arcs with round, butt or square caps, pie and donut sectors with rounded corners, and activity rings whose conic gradients follow the arc. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/arcs-and-rings.md)
- [Lines & paths](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/lines-and-paths/): Anti-aliased lines and polylines with monotone or Catmull-Rom smoothing, Bezier paths, tapered strokes and translucent joints without double blending. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/lines-and-paths.md)
- [Fills & strokes](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/fills-and-strokes/): Paint styles, stroke alignment (inside, center or outside), fill and stroke without a seam, and hairlines that fade instead of breaking up. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/fills-and-strokes.md)
- [Dashes & dots](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/dashes/): Dash patterns computed in the shader, with caps on every dash, dots from zero-length dashes, closed outlines without a seam, and marching ants. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/dashes.md)
- [Transforms](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/transforms/): Save, restore, translate, rotate and scale the drawing. Rotated and scaled primitives stay exact, and stroke widths scale with them. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/transforms.md)

### Paint

- [Paint overview](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/paint/): Gradients that do not band, and blur that turns any shape into a glow or a shadow.
- [Gradients](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/gradients/): Linear, radial, conic and along-the-path gradients in OKLab, with smooth easing. Half-float ramps and dithering keep dark gradients free of banding. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/gradients.md)
- [Blur, glows & shadows](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/blur-and-shadows/): A gaussian blur applied to each shape's distance field gives neon glows, soft drop shadows and motion blur without filters or extra passes. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/blur-and-shadows.md)
- [Inner shadows, spread and mesh](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/effects/): Figma-style inner shadows, blur spread, progressive blur, plus-lighter blending and gradient meshes in PixiJS, drawn from the same distance field. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/effects.md)
- [Glass and glow](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/glass-and-glow/): Frosted glass that blurs and bends what is behind it, and light that adds up to white: auroras, neon, beams and a prism, with pixi-silk/glass and pixi-silk/glow. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/glass-and-glow.md)

### UI widgets

- [UI widgets overview](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/ui/): Charts and sharp text, plus the first ready-made widgets and how they react to input.
- [Charts](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/charts/): Anti-aliased line and area charts with monotone smoothing that never overshoots, fading gradient fills, dotted guides, bars and dots. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/charts.md)
- [Sharp text](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/text/): SilkText draws labels and readouts from a runtime SDF glyph atlas. Text stays crisp from 0.5x to 100x zoom, with outlines, glows and tabular numbers. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/text.md)
- [Editing text](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/editing-text/): TextEditor makes SilkText clickable and editable like a design tool text layer: caret, selection, undo, clipboard and input methods, sharp at any zoom. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/editing-text.md)
- [Hit testing & events](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/hit-testing/): Pointer events test each shape's real distance field: rings are hollow, lines react only within their stroke and rounded corners stay rounded. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/hit-testing.md)
- [Animation](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/animation/): Redraw SilkGraphics cheaply every frame. Animate with damp, dampAngle, Spring and ease so motion feels the same at 60, 120 or 144 Hz. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/animation.md)
- [Radial menus and buttons](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/radial-menus-and-buttons/): Marking menus with nested rings, falloff and per-device tuning, plus buttons that animate in and out and ignore input while they move. Tree-shakeable. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/radial-menus-and-buttons.md)
- [Layout and smart containers](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/layout/): Place HUD boxes on any screen the way slot games do, with portrait and landscape records, then lay out what is inside them with a small flex engine. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/layout.md)

### Editor UI

- [Editor UI overview](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/editor-ui/): Everything a design tool draws on its canvas, from the camera and rulers to gizmos and undo.
- [Canvas and measurements](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/canvas-and-measurements/): Pan and zoom a PixiJS scene like a design tool, with pinch, fling and fit, and measure the distances between objects with redlines and size badges. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/canvas-and-measurements.md)
- [Grid, rulers and selection](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/canvas-tools/): Add a zoom-aware grid, rulers, draggable guides, rubber-band selection, group transforms and Figma-style smart spacing to a PixiJS canvas. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/canvas-tools.md)
- [Transform gizmos](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/transform-gizmos/): Move, rotate, scale and bounding-box handles with snapping, selection outlines that follow rotated objects, and smart guides for edges, centres and gaps. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/transform-gizmos.md)
- [Selection and undo](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/selection-and-history/): Track what is selected, hovered and primary in a PixiJS editor, and make every edit undoable with transactions, merging, signal recording and keyboard shortcuts. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/selection-and-history.md)
- [Path editing](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/path-editing/): Edit bezier paths in PixiJS like a design tool: drag anchors and handles, add and delete points, and draw with a pen tool. Every edit is undoable. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/path-editing.md)
- [Colour pickers](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/color-pickers/): Hue ring with triangle or square, colour wheel, OKLCH plane, channel sliders, swatches, a radial swatch popup and an eyedropper, all on one colour model. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/color-pickers.md)
- [Editor tools](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/editor-tools/): Action buttons that orbit the selection, a brush cursor with live resize and pen pressure, a hold-to-show mode ring and a sliding segmented switch. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/editor-tools.md)
- [Dials and timeline](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/dials-and-timeline/): A jog wheel with fine control and inertia, Blender-style scrub fields, a compact timeline with keys and loop range, and an odometer that rolls its digits. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/dials-and-timeline.md)
- [Panels](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/panels/): Dockable panels drawn in Pixi with no DOM: a virtualised layer tree, a schema-driven property inspector with undo, and a minimap of the camera. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/panels.md)

### Examples

- [Examples overview](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/examples/): Whole screens built with pixi-silk, from reference sheets rebuilt 1:1 to a live dashboard.
- [Showcase](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/showcase/): Five design sheets, from Health cards to Live Activities, rebuilt pixel for pixel with smooth, anti-aliased pixi-silk graphics. 81 live widgets. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/showcase.md)
- [Gallery](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/gallery/): Whole screens rebuilt with pixi-silk: a monochrome weather dashboard, a finance bento board and a sci-fi spectra HUD. Open any of them in Studio. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/gallery.md)
- [Slot HUD examples](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/slot-hud/): Copyable slot HUD controls built from pixi-silk atoms: a spin button with autoplay, win meters, multiplier badges, free-spin pips, feature paths and hold-to-buy. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/slot-hud.md)

### Rendering

- [Rendering overview](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/rendering/): How the anti-aliasing works, crisp canvases on any screen and what it costs.
- [Smooth graphics in PixiJS v8](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/smooth-graphics-pixijs/): Find the cause and fix for jagged edges, faceted circles, flickering thin lines, blurry retina canvases, blurry filters and banded gradients in PixiJS v8. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/smooth-graphics-pixijs.md)
- [Anti-aliasing in PixiJS v8](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/antialiasing-in-pixijs/): Compare six ways to get smooth graphics in PixiJS v8: MSAA, higher resolution, curve smoothness, supersampling, FXAA and analytic SDF anti-aliasing. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/antialiasing-in-pixijs.md)
- [@pixi/graphics-smooth and PixiJS v8](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/graphics-smooth-v8/): @pixi/graphics-smooth, the anti-aliased Graphics plugin, targets PixiJS v7. For smooth, anti-aliased lines and shapes on PixiJS v8, use SilkGraphics. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/graphics-smooth-v8.md)
- [Resolution & DPR](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/resolution/): createSilkApp maps the canvas 1:1 to device pixels, even at fractional DPRs, follows DPR changes and renders filters at screen resolution. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/resolution.md)
- [WebGPU & WebGL2](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/webgpu/): pixi-silk renders on Pixi WebGPU and WebGL2 with the same output. createSilkApp uses WebGL2 by default and WebGPU when you ask for it. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/webgpu.md)
- [Performance](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/performance/): One instanced draw call per SilkGraphics and about 12 ms of CPU to rebuild 50,000 primitives, plus tips for static layers, gradients and fill rate. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/performance.md)
- [How it works](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/how-it-works/): One instanced quad per primitive, exact signed distance functions per pixel, analytic coverage from screen-space derivatives and dithered OKLab ramps. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/how-it-works.md)

### Reference

- [Reference overview](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/reference/): The API reference lists every export with its JSDoc. The other pages here are for looking things up.
- [Glossary](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/glossary/): Short definitions of anti-aliasing, MSAA, SSAA, FXAA, signed distance fields, coverage, device pixel ratio, squircles, OKLab, banding and dithering. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/glossary.md)

## API reference

- [Overview](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/): every export by entry point, generated from the source JSDoc (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api.md).
- [SilkGraphics](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/classes/SilkGraphics/): Class. A PixiJS display object with a Graphics-like API. Every primitive is a signed distance field evaluated per pixel, so edges are smooth at any scale, rotation and device pixel ratio. Each object is one instanced draw call.
- [createSilkApp](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/functions/createSilkApp/): Function. Creates a Pixi application tuned for smooth vector output.
- [FillStyle](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/interfaces/FillStyle/): Interface. How a fill is painted: colour or gradient, opacity, blur with spread, blend mode and inner shadows.
- [StrokeStyle](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/interfaces/StrokeStyle/): Interface. How a stroke is painted: width (or tapered widths), alignment, caps, dashes, plus everything in FillStyle.
- [FAQ](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/faq/): short answers, grouped by area.
